candidate_claims.text: Arrears fell from 4.1 percent of GDP at end-2023 to 2.6 percent of GDP at end-2025.

evidence.excerpt: Arrears of the state-owned distribution company fell from 4.1 percent of GDP at end-2023 to 2.6 percent of GDP at end-2025.

candidate_claims.text: Tariff shortfalls accounted for roughly half of sector losses in 2025.

evidence.excerpt: Tariff shortfalls accounted for roughly half of sector losses in 2025.

candidate_claims.text: Collection rates rose from 78 percent in 2023 to 86 percent in 2025.

evidence.excerpt: Collection rates rose from 78 percent in 2023 to 86 percent in 2025.

candidate_claims.text: The cash waterfall mechanism was introduced in March 2024.

evidence.excerpt: The cash waterfall mechanism, introduced in March 2024, allocates sector revenues according to a pre-agreed priority ordering.

candidate_claims.text: In 2025, the Treasury cleared arrears equivalent to 0.9 percent of GDP through a securitization operation.

evidence.excerpt: Treasury cleared arrears equivalent to 0.9 percent of GDP in 2025 through a securitization operation.

candidate_claims.text: Average end-user tariffs remained about 20 percent below the cost-recovery level in 2025.

evidence.excerpt: Average end-user tariffs remained about 20 percent below the cost-recovery level in 2025.

research_gaps: No breakdown of arrears by creditor was found.
